title: Review on the synergistic effect of adsorption and photocatalytic degradation of patulin by functionalized graphitic carbon nitride nanomaterials and hydrogels
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24510-24535
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01082A, Review Article
Open Access

Meie Zheng, Wenwen Li, Fei Ma, Yujia Shao, Mengru Guo, Xinyue Gao, Junbo Du
Efficient removal of patulin (PAT) contamination in food presents a significant challenge for food safety. This paper reviews recent advances in g-C3N4/hydrogel integrated systems for enhancing PAT removal.
